claim: How accurate is store availability (inventory) on Walmart.com?
summary: You know, when you go to Walmart.com and check store availability for a product and it tells you if it's available or out of stock. Just wondering if it's hit or miss or pretty accurate? Edit: so far, the system is very inaccurate: called 3 stores and all 3 had the wrong availability status posted on Walmart.com.
